source.title: WFC Leader Announcement (September 2024)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Edward Hollingdale will become the new Leader of the WCA Financial Committee (WFC). Edward was already working as the Committee’s, interim leader 

Edward was selected by the WCA Board by voting, as described in Section 5 of [WCA Motion 10.2024.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf). The promotion is active as of 25 August.

We extend our support and best wishes to Edward as he takes on his new responsibilities.

Edward was the only applicant for the role and his successful candidacy document can be seen [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1AAOy0RSpks9e5kq9GMp3aUIwz1wkm8V_/view?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 财务委员会负责人任命公告（2024 年 9 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Edward Hollingdale 将成为 WCA 财务委员会（WFC）的新负责人。Edward 此前已担任委员会的临时负责人。

WCA 董事会依照 [WCA 动议 10.2024.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节的规定，通过投票选定了 Edward。任命自 8 月 25 日起生效。

我们支持 Edward，并祝愿他顺利履行新的职责。

Edward 是这一职位的唯一申请者。他的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1AAOy0RSpks9e5kq9GMp3aUIwz1wkm8V_/view?usp=sharing)查看。
